articles.title_en: Estimating macroeconomic models of financial crises: An endogenous regime‐switching approach
articles.title_cn: 估计金融危机宏观经济模型：一种内生制度转换方法
articles.abstract_en: We develop a new model of cycles and crises in emerging markets, featuring an occasionally binding borrowing constraint and stochastic volatility, and estimate it with quarterly data for Mexico since 1981. We propose an endogenous regime‐switching formulation of the occasionally binding borrowing constraint, develop a general perturbation method to solve the model, and estimate it using Bayesian methods. We find that the model fits the Mexican data well without systematically relying on large shocks, matching the typical stylized facts of emerging market business cycles and Mexico's history of sudden stops in capital flows. We also find that interest rate shocks play a smaller role in driving both cycles and crises than previously found in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个新兴市场周期与危机的新模型，其特点是偶尔具有约束力的借款约束和随机波动性，并使用墨西哥自1981年以来的季度数据对其进行估计。我们提出了偶尔具有约束力的借款约束的内生制度转换公式，开发了一种通用的扰动方法来解决该模型，并使用贝叶斯方法进行估计。我们发现该模型很好地拟合了墨西哥数据，无需系统性地依赖大冲击，符合新兴市场商业周期的典型风格化事实以及墨西哥资本流动突然停止的历史。我们还发现，利率冲击在驱动周期和危机方面的作用比先前文献中发现的要小。

articles.title_cn: 综合流行病-经济评估：定量理论
articles.abstract_en: Aimed at pandemic preparedness, we construct a framework for integrated epi‐econ assessment that we believe would be useful for policymakers, especially at the early stages of a pandemic outbreak. We offer theory, calibration to micro‐, macro‐, and epi‐data, and numerical methods for quantitative policy evaluation. The model has an explicit microeconomic, market‐based structure. It highlights trade‐offs, within period and over time, associated with activities that involve both valuable social interaction and harmful disease transmission. We compare market solutions with socially optimal allocations. Our calibration to Covid‐19 implies that households shift their leisure and work activities away from social interactions. This is especially true for older individuals, who are more vulnerable to disease. The optimal allocation may or may not involve lockdown and changes the time allocations significantly across age groups. In this trade‐off, people's social leisure time becomes an important factor, aside from deaths and GDP. We finally compare optimal responses to different viruses (SARS, seasonal flu) and argue that, going forward, economic analysis ought to be an integral element behind epidemiological policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 旨在为流行病防范，我们构建了一个综合流行病-经济评估框架，我们认为该框架对政策制定者尤其在大流行病爆发初期会很有用。我们提供了理论、对微观、宏观和流行病数据的校准，以及用于定量政策评估的数值方法。该模型具有明确的微观经济、基于市场的结构。它强调了在涉及有价值的社会互动和有害的疾病传播的活动中，期内和跨期的权衡。我们比较了市场解决方案与社会最优配置。我们对Covid-19的校准表明，家庭将休闲和工作活动从社会互动中转移出来。对于更容易感染疾病的老年人尤其如此。最优配置可能涉及也可能不涉及封锁，并显著改变不同年龄组的时间分配。在这种权衡中，除了死亡和GDP之外，人们的社会休闲时间成为一个重要因素。最后，我们比较了对不同病毒（SARS、季节性流感）的最优反应，并认为，展望未来，经济分析应成为流行病政策的一个组成部分。

articles.title_en: Prospering through Prospera: A dynamic model of CCT impacts on educational attainment and achievement in Mexico
articles.title_cn: 通过Prospera实现繁荣：墨西哥有条件现金转移对教育成就和学业成绩影响的动态模型
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops and estimates a dynamic model, which integrates value‐added and school‐choice models, to evaluate grade‐by‐grade and cumulative impacts of the Mexican Prospera conditional cash transfer (CCT) program on educational achievement. The empirical application advances the previous literature by estimating policy impacts on learning, accounting for dynamic selective school attendance, and incorporating both observed and unobserved heterogeneity. A dynamic framework is critical for estimating cumulative learning effects because lagged achievements are important determinants of current achievements. The model is estimated using rich nationwide Mexican administrative data on schooling progression and mathematics and Spanish test scores in grades 4–9 along with student and family survey data. The estimates show significant CCT impacts on learning and educational attainment, particularly for students from poorer households. Results show that telesecondary schools (distance learning) play a crucial role in facilitating school attendance and in fostering skill accumulation.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发并估计了一个动态模型，该模型整合了增值模型和学校选择模型，以评估墨西哥Prospera有条件现金转移（CCT）项目对教育成就的逐年和累积影响。实证应用通过估计政策对学习的影响、考虑动态选择性学校出勤，并纳入观测和未观测的异质性，推进了先前文献。动态框架对于估计累积学习效应至关重要，因为滞后的成就是当前成就的重要决定因素。该模型使用墨西哥全国范围内关于学校进展以及4-9年级数学和西班牙语测试成绩的丰富行政数据，以及学生和家庭调查数据进行估计。估计结果显示，CCT对学习和教育成就具有显著影响，特别是对来自较贫困家庭的学生。结果表明，远程中学（远程学习）在促进学校出勤和促进技能积累方面发挥着关键作用。

articles.title_en: Can teaching be taught? Improving teachers' pedagogical skills at scale in rural Peru
articles.title_cn: 教学可以教吗？大规模提高秘鲁农村地区教师的教学技能
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the impact of a large‐scale teacher coaching program in Peru, a context with high teacher turnover, on teachers' pedagogical skills and student learning. Previous studies find that small‐scale coaching programs can improve teaching of reading and science in developing countries. However, scaling up can reduce programs' effectiveness, and teacher turnover can erode compliance and cause spillovers onto non‐program schools. We develop a framework that defines different treatment effects when teacher turnover is present, and explains which effects can be estimated. We evaluate this teacher coaching program, exploiting random assignment of that program's expansion to 3797 rural schools in 2016. After two years, teachers assigned to the program increased their aggregate pedagogical skills by 0.20 standard deviations. The program also increased student learning; after 1 year, Grade 2 students' mathematics and reading scores increased by 0.106 and 0.075 standard deviations (of the distributions of those test scores), respectively. After three years, the cumulative effect increases slightly, to 0.114 and 0.100, respectively. One reason why these impacts are low is that some uncoached teachers moved into treated schools in years 2 and 3. Following our framework, we estimate that the impacts on students of having a “fully” coached teacher for all three years are 0.18 and 0.16 standard deviations for mathematics and reading comprehension, respectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了秘鲁大规模教师辅导计划（教师流动率高）对教师教学技能和学生学习的影响。先前的研究发现，小规模辅导项目可以改善发展中国家的阅读和科学教学。然而，扩大规模可能会降低项目的有效性，而教师流动可能会削弱合规性并导致溢出效应到非项目学校。我们开发了一个框架，定义了教师流动时的不同处理效果，并解释了可以估计哪些效果。我们评估了该教师辅导计划，利用该计划扩展到 2016 的 3797 农村学校的随机分配。两年后，分配到该项目的教师的总体教学技能提高了 0.20 个标准差。该计划还增加了学生的学习； 1年后，2年级学生的数学和阅读成绩分别增加了0.106和0.075标准差（这些测试成绩的分布）。三年后，累积效应略有增加，分别达到 0.114 和 0.100。这些影响较低的原因之一是一些未经培训的教师在2和3年进入接受过培训的学校。根据我们的框架，我们估计三年内拥有“完全”辅导的教师对学生的数学和阅读理解标准差分别为 0.18 和 0.16 标准差。

articles.title_en: An ordinal approach to the empirical analysis of games with monotone best responses
articles.title_cn: 单调最优反应博弈经验分析的序数方法
articles.abstract_en: We develop a nonparametric and ordinal approach for testing pure strategy Nash equilibrium play in games with monotone best responses, such as those with strategic complements/substitutes. The approach makes minimal assumptions on unobserved heterogeneity, requires no parametric assumptions on payoff functions, and no restriction on equilibrium selection from multiple equilibria. The approach can also be extended in order to make inferences and predictions. Both model‐testing and inference can be implemented by a tractable computation procedure based on column generation. To illustrate how our approach works, we include an application to an IO entry game.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一种非参数和序数方法，用于检验具有单调最优反应的博弈中的纯策略纳什均衡行为，例如具有战略互补/替代性的博弈。该方法对未观测到的异质性做出最小假设，不需要对支付函数进行参数假设，也不限制多重均衡中的均衡选择。该方法还可以扩展以进行推断和预测。模型检验和推断都可以通过基于列生成的易处理计算程序来实现。为了说明我们的方法如何运作，我们包含了一个应用于产业组织进入博弈的实例。

articles.title_en: Econometrics of insurance with multidimensional types
articles.title_cn: 多维类型保险的计量经济学
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we address the identification and estimation of insurance models where insurees have private information about their risk and risk aversion. The model includes random damages and allows for several claims, while insurees choose from a finite number of coverages. We show that the joint distribution of risk and risk aversion is nonparametrically identified despite bunching due to multidimensional types and a finite number of coverages. Our identification strategy exploits the observed number of claims as well as an exclusion restriction, and a full support assumption. Furthermore, our results apply to any form of competition. We propose a novel estimation procedure combining nonparametric estimators and GMM estimation that we illustrate in a Monte Carlo study.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了保险模型的识别与估计问题，其中被保险人对其风险和风险厌恶拥有私人信息。该模型包括随机损失，并允许多次索赔，而被保险人从有限数量的保障中选择。我们证明，尽管由于多维类型和有限数量的保障而存在聚集现象，风险与风险厌恶的联合分布仍可非参数识别。我们的识别策略利用了观察到的索赔次数以及排除性限制和完全支持假设。此外，我们的结果适用于任何形式的竞争。我们提出了一种结合非参数估计量和GMM估计的新估计程序，并在蒙特卡洛研究中进行了说明。

articles.title_en: Double robust inference for continuous updating GMM
articles.title_cn: 连续更新GMM的双重稳健推断
articles.abstract_en: We propose the double robust Lagrange multiplier (DRLM) statistic for testing hypotheses specified on the minimizer of the population continuous updating objective function. The (bounding) χ2 limiting distribution of the DRLM statistic is robust to both misspecification and weak identification, hence its name. The minimizer is the so‐called pseudo‐true value, which equals the true value of the structural parameter under correct specification. To emphasize its importance for applied work where misspecification and weak identification are common, we use the DRLM test to analyze: the risk premia in Adrian et al. (2014) and He et al. (2017); the structural parameters in a nonlinear asset pricing model with constant relative risk aversion.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了双重稳健拉格朗日乘数（DRLM）统计量，用于检验关于总体连续更新目标函数最小化器的假设。DRLM统计量的（有界）χ2极限分布对误设和弱识别均具有稳健性，因此得名。该最小化器即所谓的伪真值，在正确设定下等于结构参数的真值。为了强调其在误设和弱识别常见的应用工作中的重要性，我们使用DRLM检验分析了：Adrian等人（2014）和He等人（2017）中的风险溢价；以及具有常数相对风险厌恶的非线性资产定价模型中的结构参数。

articles.title_en: How much do we learn? Measuring symmetric and asymmetric deviations from Bayesian updating through choices
articles.title_cn: 我们学到了多少？通过选择衡量贝叶斯更新的对称与非对称偏离
articles.abstract_en: Belief‐updating biases hinder the correction of inaccurate beliefs and lead to suboptimal decisions. We complement Rabin and Schrag's (1999) portable extension of the Bayesian model by including conservatism in addition to confirmatory bias. Additionally, we show how to identify these two forms of biases from choices. In an experiment, we found that the subjects exhibited confirmatory bias by misreading 19% of the signals that contradicted their priors. They were also conservative and acted as if they missed 28% of the signals.
articles.abstract_cn: 信念更新偏差阻碍了不准确信念的纠正，并导致次优决策。我们通过将保守主义与确认偏误一同纳入，补充了Rabin和Schrag（1999）对贝叶斯模型的可移植扩展。此外，我们展示了如何从选择中识别这两种形式的偏差。在一项实验中，我们发现受试者表现出确认偏误，误读了19%与其先验相矛盾的信号。他们还表现出保守主义，行为上似乎遗漏了28%的信号。
